spans.s: सैरंध्र m. 1. A menial servant; 2. the son of a Dasyu by an Āyogava female, (सैरिंध्र वागुरावृत्तिं सुते दस्युरयोगवे M.x.32).
सैरंध्र m. 1. A menial servant; 2. the son of a Dasyu by an Āyogava female, (सैरिंध्र वागुरावृत्तिं सुते दस्युरयोगवे M.x.32).

सैरंध्री f. 1. A maid-servant (a woman of the mixed tribe described in the preceding word); 2. an independent female artizan working in another person’s house; 3. an epithet of Draupadī (when a servant of Virāṭa’s queen).

सैरिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a plough; 2. having furrows.
सैरिक (II) m. 1. A plough-ox; 2. a ploughman.
सैरिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a plough; 2. having furrows.
सैरिभ m. 1. A buffalo, अवमानित इव कुलीनो दीर्घं निःश्वसिति सैरिभः Mrich.iv.; 2. Indra’s heaven.
